label: Result · continue
heading: Assessment result — you may continue online
lede: The first message most clients receive. It confirms the result without promising acceptance, and carries the fee so there is no surprise at checkout.
trigger: the assessment resolves to the continue-online outcome.
emailTitle: You may continue through our online service
emailBody: Thank you for completing the free assessment. Your answers indicate that your circumstances may be suitable for the standard online UAE Will service.
The next step is to create your account, read the engagement terms and pay the professional fee. Nothing is charged until you have read what is included.
ctaNote: This link is personal to you. It does not expire.
caveat: This is not final acceptance by any authority, and your Will has not yet been prepared or registered. Government, court, registry and notary charges are separate from the fee above.
waBody: Hello {{1}}, thank you for completing the UAE Expat Wills assessment. You may continue through our online service.
Reference {{2}}. The professional fee is AED 2,199 plus VAT for one accepted standard Will. Government and court charges are separate.
waFooter: Summit Legal Consultancy UAE · Trade Licence 4429232.01. Not a court or government authority.

label: Result · held
heading: Assessment result — held for legal review
lede: The most delicate message in the set. It must not read as a rejection, must not name which answer caused the hold, and must not mention payment.
trigger: the assessment resolves to the held outcome, for any of the review triggers.
emailTitle: We would like our legal team to review your circumstances first
emailBody: Thank you for completing the free assessment. This is not a rejection.

One or more of your answers means we should look at your matter before recommending a service, a registration authority or a price. A member of the legal team will contact you using the details you gave us.
There is nothing to pay at this stage, and nothing you entered has been lost.
cta: Give us a time that suits you
caveat: No payment is requested while a matter is held for review. We will explain the proposed service and any fee before anything is charged.
waBody: Hello {{1}}, thank you for completing the UAE Expat Wills assessment. Our legal team would like to review your circumstances before recommending a service. This is not a rejection.
Reference {{2}}. There is nothing to pay at this stage. We will contact you within one business day.
waFooter: Summit Legal Consultancy UAE · Trade Licence 4429232.01. Not a court or government authority.

label: Payment receipt
heading: Payment receipt with VAT
lede: A tax document, so the figures are tabular and the separate-charge line is not buried. It states plainly that paying does not register anything.
trigger: a payment is captured, whether by card, bank transfer or cash recorded by an administrator.
emailBody: Thank you. We have received your payment and your matter is now open with the legal team.
Your next step is the detailed questionnaire. We will email a secure link to it shortly.

table.k: One standard UAE Will — professional fee

ctaNote: Also available any time in your account.
caveat: This payment covers the professional work described in your Service Confirmation. It does not register a Will. Government, court, registry, notary, certification, attestation, courier and identity-verification charges are separate.
waBody: Hello {{1}}, we have received your payment of AED {{2}} for reference {{3}}. Your matter is now open with our legal team.
Your receipt is in your account. Paying does not itself register a Will — government and court charges are separate.
waFooter: Summit Legal Consultancy UAE · Trade Licence 4429232.01.
variables: {{1}} first name · {{2}} total paid · {{3}} case reference

label: Questionnaire released
heading: Detailed questionnaire released
lede: Carries the time-limited magic link. The expiry is stated twice — once in the body and once beside the button — because an expired link is the most common support message.
trigger: payment is confirmed and the questionnaire is released to the account.
emailBody: This is where you give us your instructions: beneficiaries, executors, guardianship wishes where your route permits, and your assets.
It saves as you go, so you can leave and return. Most people take about thirty minutes over it, and there is no advantage in rushing.
ctaNote: This link is valid for 24 hours and works once. Request a new one any time from your account.
caveat: Please do not send instructions, identity documents or asset details by email or message. Everything is exchanged inside your secure account.
waBody: Hello {{1}}, your detailed Will questionnaire is now open for reference {{2}}.
We have emailed a secure link to {{3}}. It is valid for 24 hours and works once.
waFooter: Summit Legal Consultancy UAE · Trade Licence 4429232.01.
variables: {{1}} first name · {{2}} case reference · {{3}} masked email

label: Further information
heading: Further information required
lede: Attention, never critical. It names the question and says the matter is not at risk, because a request for information reads as a problem unless you say otherwise.
trigger: a consultant raises a clarification on an open case.
emailTitle: One clarification before we continue drafting
emailBody: Dr. Mohamed Raouf has a question about the property listed in section 8 of your questionnaire. The title deed names two parties, but the property is recorded as solely owned.
Your matter is not at risk and nothing further is payable. Drafting continues as soon as this is answered — usually the same working day.
caveat: Please answer inside your account rather than by reply. Email is not a secure channel for matter detail.
waBody: Hello {{1}}, our legal team has one question about your matter, reference {{2}}. Nothing further is payable and your matter is not at risk.
Please open your account to answer. Drafting continues as soon as we have your reply.
waFooter: Summit Legal Consultancy UAE · Trade Licence 4429232.01.

label: Draft ready
heading: Draft ready for review
lede: The moment the product earns its fee. It says the draft has had human legal review, and that it must not be treated as ready for signing until we say so.
trigger: legal review completes and a draft is released to the client.
emailTitle: Your draft Will is ready to read
emailBody: Dr. Mohamed Raouf has completed the legal review of your instructions and prepared your first draft.
Read it in full, including the schedules. Your service includes two rounds of amendments, and nothing is submitted anywhere until you personally approve the final wording.
ctaNote: Two amendment rounds are included in your service.
caveat: A draft must not be treated as ready for signing or registration until Summit confirms the relevant next step. Approving the wording does not register the Will.
waBody: Hello {{1}}, your draft Will for reference {{2}} has completed legal review and is ready to read in your account.
Nothing is submitted anywhere until you approve the final wording.
waFooter: Summit Legal Consultancy UAE · Trade Licence 4429232.01.

label: Draft approved
heading: Draft approved
lede: A confirmation that must resist the obvious overclaim. Approval is the client's act; registration is the authority's.
trigger: the client records their approval of the final wording.
emailTitle: You have approved your final wording
emailBody: Thank you. We have recorded your approval of the final wording, timestamped 19 August 2026 at 16:22 Gulf Standard Time.
We now prepare the certified translation and the submission pack, and we will confirm the expected authority charge before you authorise it.
caveat: Approving the wording does not register the Will and does not commit any authority. Registration is completed by the competent authority under its own current requirements.
waBody: Hello {{1}}, we have recorded your approval of the final wording for reference {{2}}.
We now prepare the translation and submission pack, and will confirm the authority charge before you authorise it.
waFooter: Summit Legal Consultancy UAE · Trade Licence 4429232.01. Registration is completed by the authority.

label: Appointment
heading: Registration appointment
lede: Passes on the authority's own offer without dressing it as a promise. What to bring is a list, because that is what gets forgotten.
trigger: the authority offers appointment times for identity check and signing.
emailTitle: The authority has offered appointment times
emailBody: The Civil Wills Office has offered the following times for your identity check and signing. Reply in your account with the one that suits you and we will confirm it.
Bring the original passport and Emirates ID you gave us. A copy is not accepted at the appointment.
caveat: Appointment availability and requirements are set by the authority and can change. Attendance and identity verification remain personal steps we cannot complete for you.
waBody: Hello {{1}}, the authority has offered appointment times for reference {{2}}. Please choose one in your account by {{3}}.
Bring your original passport and Emirates ID. Copies are not accepted.
waFooter: Summit Legal Consultancy UAE · Trade Licence 4429232.01.
variables: {{1}} first name · {{2}} case reference · {{3}} reply-by date

label: Completion
heading: Completion
lede: The last message, and the one people keep. It says where the documents are and what would make the Will need revisiting.
trigger: the authority records the registration and the final documents are delivered.
emailBody: The authority accepted the application on 2 September 2026 and issued its receipt. Your registered Will, its certified translation and the receipt are in your account.

Tell your executor where the registered Will is kept. A Will should be reviewed after any significant change — marriage, divorce or separation, a birth or adoption, the death of someone you named, or acquiring or disposing of a significant asset.
ctaNote: They stay available in your account. Ask us any time for further copies.
caveat: Registration is an authority process. It does not guarantee future validity, enforcement or any particular outcome after death.
waBody: Hello {{1}}, the authority has registered your Will for reference {{2}} and issued its receipt.
Your documents are in your account. Please tell your executor where the registered Will is kept.
waFooter: Summit Legal Consultancy UAE · Trade Licence 4429232.01.

label: ◆ Internal · new lead
heading: New lead alert
lede: Goes to both administrator numbers. It carries the reference and the outcome bucket and nothing else — enough to act, not enough to leak.
trigger: any assessment completes, on both administrator numbers and the shared inbox.
emailBody: An assessment completed and resolved to: held for legal review. Owner assigned to Dr. M. Raouf by routing rule R-07.
First-contact target is 4 working hours. Two trigger reasons are readable in the case; one further trigger is restricted and readable only by authorised legal staff inside the case record.
caveat: This alert deliberately omits the restricted trigger content. It names no question, no answer and no reason — those are readable only inside the case, by authorised legal staff.
waBody: Reference {{1}} completed at {{2}} and resolved to: {{3}}.
Assigned to {{4}}. First contact due {{5}}. Open the admin case for detail.
waFooter: Internal alert. Do not forward. Case detail is not included in this message.
variables: {{1}} reference · {{2}} time · {{3}} outcome bucket · {{4}} owner · {{5}} due time

label: ◆ Internal · overdue
heading: Countdown overdue escalation
lede: Escalation, so it is allowed to be critical. It states which countdown breached and by how long, and nothing about the client's circumstances.
trigger: a countdown passes its threshold during working hours; repeats every 2 hours until acknowledged.
emailBody: The first-contact countdown on this case breached 4 hours ago and has not been acknowledged. One outbound call was attempted at 14:02 with no answer, and a WhatsApp message was sent at 14:20.
This is the second escalation. It repeats every 2 hours during working hours until someone records contact or reassigns the case.
caveat: Escalations name the countdown and the case reference only. No client circumstance, answer or restricted flag appears in an escalation.
waBody: Reference {{1}}: the {{2}} countdown is overdue by {{3}}. Owner {{4}}.
Escalation {{5}}. Acknowledge or reassign in the admin tool.
waFooter: Internal alert. Do not forward. Case detail is not included in this message.
variables: {{1}} reference · {{2}} countdown name · {{3}} overdue by · {{4}} owner · {{5}} escalation count
